sentences.text: JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous 2nd Bail Application No. 8211/2022 Ramesh @ Rameshwar Jat S/o Jawahar Mal Jat, Aged About 22 Years, Sundri, P.s. Gangrar At Present Chanderia, P.s. Chanderia Dist. Chittorgarh (Raj.).

(At Present Lodged In Chittorgarh Jail).
 ----Petitioner  Versus 1. State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp 2. Bholi Ram S/o Soram Bheel, R/o Bheedsar Ps Kotwali  Dist. Chittorgarh  ----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Pritam Joshi.

For Respondent(s) : Mr. AR Choudhary, PP.
 HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE PUSHPENDRA SINGH BHATI Order 20/04/2023
This Court perused the material available on record.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.358/2020 of Police Station Kotwali, District Chittorgarh for the offences punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376 (2)(N) of the IPC & Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act of 2012.
He has preferred this second bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has drawn attention of this Court towards the statement of PW-1 (Prosecutrix), in which, the consent is reflected to a very large extent.
Learned counsel further submits that the petitioner is in custody since 10.08.2020.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case as also the fact that conclusion of the proceedings is [2023/RJJD/011179] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-8211/2022] likely to take some time and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court deems it just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.

sentences.text: Accordingly, this second bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Ramesh @ Rameshwar Jat S/o Jawahar Mal Jat shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.358/2020 of Police Station Kotwali, District Chittorgarh provided he executes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.

(DR.PUSHPENDRA SINGH BHATI), J.
